head.t: FDA clears Masimo's smartSedLine brain function monitor
head.x: FDA has cleared Masimo's smartSedLine EEG-based brain monitoring system, which computes a Patient State Index to aid anaesthesia, with an updated algorithm aimed at elderly and high-risk surgical patients. Works with Masimo Root and O3 Regional Oximetry.
